pk.context: 50 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: Its 13-cis isomer accumulates 6.6-fold in plasma, against 1.2-fold for the parent drug.

clues.text: About 72% of the dose is absorbed, and absorption is optimal with food. It is more than 99.9% bound to plasma proteins, mainly albumin.
A yellow to greenish-yellow powder with molecular weight 326.44; chemically a nonatetraenoic acid.
Gelatin capsules under an NDA, in 10 and 25 mg strengths.
Boxed warning against use in pregnancy, or in the 3 years after stopping. Contraindicated with severely impaired liver or kidney function and with methotrexate; reactions resemble hypervitaminosis A.
Severe skin disease in adults, reserved for non-pregnant patients unresponsive to other therapies.
The label states no mechanism of action; it is a retinoid related to both retinoic acid and retinol (vitamin A).
The generic name begins with A and has nine letters.
